Source: https://github.com/Z-eq/lab-ccna

Pinned revision: c118060c0ac4fb5ecc805787fad1be17bc9d81a6

Included on the project owner's statement that permission to use the code has been obtained. This notice does not grant additional redistribution rights. Retain the author's permission with project records.

Only JavaScript simulator modules, the SVG topology renderer and lab definitions are included. The upstream React UI, browser admin gate, AI proxy, images and deployment configuration are not included.
Local changes: explicit .js import extensions for Node ESM; task matching uses token boundaries rather than partial-word matches; repaired a missing PC symbol opening tag in the SVG renderer so generated diagrams are valid standalone images; router-only topologies use a circular layout to avoid overlapping links.
The engine is an educational command/configuration simulator, not Cisco IOS or packet-level network emulation. Imported templates require administrator review before publication.
